description: Deliver the Workflow-direct mohist/pi path end to end: pin and verify the bundled Pi SDK, implement the in-process PiRuntime, make Workflow AgentSession coordination and binding runtime-aware without breaking OpenCode, durably report Session facts, and expose Pi-backed Session milestones without adding AgentJob, Session-command, or model-catalog UI scope.

tasks.title: Pin Pi SDK and verify the runtime/toolchain contract
tasks.description: Pin @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to an exact Runner dependency, raise every documented and enforced Node floor to 22.19, and make local version managers, source-install docs, CI, and Docker select a compatible concrete release. Run the real-SDK smoke before any product implementation, record the verified service, Session, Prompt, event, trust, model, and interruption surfaces, and reconcile upstream drift into the canonical runtime call map.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/runner/package.json pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to an exact version, package-lock.json is updated through the Runner workspace npm command, and no ACP/RPC adapter dependency is added

The root and Runner package manifests require Node >=22.19; .nvmrc pins a concrete compatible release; CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/self-host.md advertise >=22.19; every setup-node workflow including ci.yml and web-test-shuffle.yml plus the Docker builder install an explicit compatible release rather than an unspecified Node 22 minor

openspec/changes/issue-450/sdk-smoke-verification.json records only pinned package/Node versions, operation names, pass/fail booleans, and sanitized field-name/type summaries for ModelRuntime/catalog, project-untrusted resources, SessionManager create/open, sessionFile identity, createAgentSession, literal Prompt completion, messages/events, model/thinking selection, steer, abort, and stop confirmation
The smoke proves repository-local .pi settings/extensions/packages/skills/prompts are not loaded while global Pi configuration and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context remain available

The smoke identifies stable message/tool/usage/retry identities, the final Session message surfaces usable for restart reconciliation, and the option that disables prompt-template expansion without recording environment/auth values, provider responses, Prompt/message bodies, or raw SDK objects
A secret scan of the smoke artifact and staged change passes before commit; a sentinel credential used by the smoke wrapper is absent from the artifact even on a failed operation
Any SDK drift found by the smoke is reflected in design/runtimes/pi.md and openspec/changes/issue-450/design.md before T-002 starts

A repository-wide search accounts for every active Node version declaration and finds no manifest, lockfile, version-manager file, source-install document, workflow, or container path that can select or advertise a release below 22.19
A clean npm ci succeeds on Node >=22.19, and npm run typecheck -w packages/runner passes with the pinned dependency
tasks.output: Pinned Pi SDK and Node toolchain updates in package manifests, lockfile, .nvmrc, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/self-host.md, every CI workflow, and Docker, plus sdk-smoke-verification.json and any required call-map reconciliation
tasks.notes: Plan-wide hard gate before every implementation task. The smoke uses real Pi and may require configured provider credentials; if the environment cannot verify the required surface, record the blocker and do not start T-002 through T-007 from assumptions. Do not add product code, AgentJob routing, Session commands, or Pi catalog reporting here.

tasks.title: Implement the in-process PiRuntime deep module
tasks.description: Create packages/runner/src/runtime/pi as a complete deep module with Mohist-owned boundary types, injectable SDK services, project-untrusted resource setup, credential confinement/redaction, readiness/catalog state, physical Session create/open/cache/dispose, literal Prompt execution, per-turn model/thinking selection, event projection/reconciliation, deadline/cancellation/provider interruption, execution quarantine, provider policy, and normalized errors. Parse Runner provider policy once and supply the same pure object to OpenCode and Pi without introducing a generic AgentRuntime interface.
acceptanceCriteria: All @earendil-works/pi SDK imports are confined to packages/runner/src/runtime/pi, and callers/tests consume only Mohist-owned Pi request/result/diagnostic types

start()/ready()/diagnostic() become ready only after SDK services initialize and getAvailable completes; an empty catalog is ready with a warning, while initialization/catalog failure stays not-ready with an actionable diagnostic and retryable start path

cli.ts parses MOHIST_PROVIDER_RETRY_THRESHOLD as a positive integer defaulting to 5 and MOHIST_PROVIDER_NON_RECOVERABLE_TERMS as a JSON array of non-empty literal strings; invalid values block Pi readiness and operator text is escaped rather than evaluated as regular expressions

Runner startup configuration carries one parsed provider policy object; OpenCode consumes that object and PiRuntime accepts the same object, with tests proving non-default threshold/literal terms reach both runtime boundaries and preserve existing OpenCode defaults

The SDK factory fixes project trust to false, gives global authentication only to Pi's auth manager, loads repository instruction files, and supplies no repository-local .pi execution resources; Mohist-owned boundary types contain no credential fields or raw SDK objects

createSession returns the normalized absolute session-file path and rejects a missing path as incompatible-runtime; restoring uses SessionManager.open and a missing/corrupt file returns missing-session without implicit creation

runTurn applies supplied model and thinking level on the existing Session, preserves the complete model remainder after the first slash, submits slash-prefixed Prompts literally, awaits prompt() as the only completion authority, reads final assistant text from messages, and never issues a second wait or replays an uncertain Prompt

Runtime tests prove omitted model does not call setModel, omitted variant does not call setThinkingLevel, each independently preserves a restored Session's current selection, and a new Session with either or both omitted retains Pi defaults

The event projector maps assistant/reasoning/tool/model/usage facts with separate input/output/cache-read/cache-write/thought dimensions, persists smoke-verified fingerprints through caller-owned state, reconciles final messages, and treats unknown events as diagnostics only

Fake-timer tests cover a caller-declared duration converted to an absolute deadline from the injected clock immediately before SDK Prompt, one wrap-up warning, result fixation, external cancellation, late completion, confirmed abort, and no replay; Workflow's fixed duration/context wiring is owned by T-006

An unconfirmed timeout, cancellation, or provider-triggered abort creates a generation-scoped physical quarantine and synchronously publishes ordered entered before returning; observed stop publishes matching cleared, stale-generation clear cannot remove a newer quarantine, other paths remain available, and Runner restart starts with no in-process execution quarantine

Provider-policy tests cover first-event quota/credit/billing failure, recoverable retries below the configured threshold, threshold-N failure, Pi-native terminal error normalization, confirmed and unconfirmed provider abort, logical/physical quarantine signal, and binding preservation

Pi-boundary credential tests inject sentinel environment/auth/provider values and prove they are absent from PiRuntime requests/results/diagnostics and task-log output while surfaced text contains the existing CredentialMasker placeholder; downstream registration/event/outbox/Action sinks are verified when those integrations exist in T-006
Runtime tests use fake SDK services, virtual paths, and fake timers only; npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and npm test -w packages/runner pass
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/runtime/pi deep module, validated shared provider-policy configuration, and deterministic fake-SDK runtime tests
tasks.notes: Implements design D1, the Pi-runtime half of D3, D7, and the projector half of D8. It does not register mohist/pi, alter Workflow Session routes, implement AgentJob Pi execution, or add Session commands.

tasks.title: Make Workflow Session coordination and binding runtime-aware
tasks.description: Introduce the shared WorkflowSessionTurnCoordinator used by every Workflow Inline Agent task lifecycle and full existing OpenCode Session-command lifetimes; carry canonical Workflow source identity on Compact/Reset delivery; make only Workflow open/bind and a new Action-owned event route runtime-aware; and add AgentSession Action stream state plus atomic drained-stream rebind/Reset transitions. Migrate the existing mohist/opencode caller atomically while leaving current Workflow Follow-up and generic event DTO/routes unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowSessionTurnCoordinator serializes by projectId/WorkflowRunId/sessionName from before open through Action execution, successful completion checks, any worktree cleanup turn, and a caller-supplied final-report phase; its test API exposes preparing versus Runtime-slot-reserved phases, removes settled task tails, tracks physical-path/quarantine-generation associations, and allows different keys to run independently

Server SessionCommandRequest adds optional projectId/workflowRunId/sessionName only for Workflow-origin Compact/Reset, derived from canonical Session source metadata; generic commands omit them, Follow-up retains its existing keyed payload, and Runner handlers use the supplied key without requiring a prior open-side reverse mapping

Workflow-origin OpenCode idle Follow-up, Compact, and Reset acquire a command lease on that key before Runtime entry; Follow-up releases on session.closed/session.followup_failed, while Compact/Reset call an authenticated idempotent Server completion endpoint with operationId and release only after grain acknowledgement; definite preflight failure uses abandon, and host reconstruction starts with no in-process leases while persisted reservations remain

The Runner completion endpoint applies Compact/Reset exactly once, Reset includes expected Action stream/drained sequence, duplicate operationId returns the persisted outcome, stale/rejected completion is actionable, and the waiting public API route reads that outcome without invoking the grain completion transition again

mohist/opencode enters the shared coordinator for its complete task lifecycle; concurrent OpenCode/OpenCode and OpenCode/Pi test operations on one key cannot overlap, queued same-name work cannot intervene between a turn and cleanup, and different keys can

Workflow Session open requires runtime opencode or pi and returns observed runtime/binding/workDir/Runner plus current authority-issued actionStreamId/lastAppliedSequence; the existing OpenCode caller sends runtime opencode atomically with the Server contract change

AgentSession persists nullable current Action stream state with append-only serializer IDs: first bind creates an opaque authority-issued ID at cursor 0, repeated open/attach returns it unchanged, and open atomically backfills exactly one ID at cursor 0 for a legacy OpenCode binding without changing binding or lineage

Workflow bind carries target runtime, expected current runtime/session/actionStreamId, and for rebind the current owning Runner plus drainedThroughSequence; an unbound Session has no stream until first bind

A guarded cross-runtime rebind in either direction preserves logical identity/workDir, appends one lineage entry, and succeeds only when expected binding/stream/Runner match and the current Server cursor equals drainedThroughSequence; it atomically installs a fresh authority-issued stream at cursor 0

The successful rebind seals the old stream and installs the new binding in one AgentSession transition; mismatch, gap, stale expectation, another Runner's attestation, same-runtime different physical ID, pending Follow-up, pending Compact/Reset, or authoritative active command state rejects without either mutation

Workflow-origin OpenCode PrepareReset returns or bootstraps current Action stream state, and CompleteReset requires expected actionStreamId plus drainedThroughSequence to replace physical binding and fresh stream atomically; generic Reset remains unchanged and Pi Reset remains unavailable without OpenCode fallback

A dedicated Workflow Action runtime-event DTO/route carries the authority-issued stream identity, physical binding, and sequence; the existing AgentSessionRuntimeEventsRequest plus Workflow Follow-up/failure-outbox and generic routes remain wire-compatible and unsequenced

The Action-event transition acknowledges sequence <= cursor without reapplying, accepts only cursor + 1, and rejects gaps, sealed streams, and stale physical bindings before transcript/usage/model mutation; existing Session-command events remain binding-validated outside the Action cursor

AgentUsageSummary, Session grain state/transition and surrogate, runtime-event parser, AgentUsageDto/read models, activity projections, and DTO mappers add nullable CachedWriteTokens/cachedWriteTokens with new append-only serializer IDs and no renumbering of existing fields
The authoritative workDir remains immutable and mismatch rejects before binding mutation; Pi is registered while historical runtime fallback and generic AgentJob DTO/routes remain unchanged

Server and Runner coverage includes existing OpenCode and Workflow Follow-up/failure-outbox regression paths, Action-versus-command DTO routing, first/idempotent bind, concurrent legacy bootstrap, zero-event rebind, symmetric lineage, expected-binding/stream races, atomic seal/fresh-stream failure and success, duplicate/gap/sealed/stale Action events, separate cache-read/cache-write accumulation and old-state deserialization, workspace mismatch, Pi registration, persistence/reactivation, and coordinator cleanup concurrency

Race tests cover command lease before same-binding Workflow reuse and before bind/rebind, Workflow lease before command delivery even before open, command arrival between bind and Runtime slot reservation, active OpenCode Follow-up steering only after slot reservation, release after acknowledged completion, duplicate callback, callback transport failure retaining the lease, Reset drain versus Workflow lease, and rejection during the gap between original and cleanup Prompts; no Prompts overlap

Coordinator quarantine tests register logical-to-physical tracking before Runtime execution, apply entered before lease release, clear only the matching generation after observed stop, ignore stale clear, unregister normal turns, and start empty when reconstructed after Runner restart

Coordinator identity tests prove identical session names remain isolated across different projects and WorkflowRuns as well as different names, while Session Action events including final/end facts never mutate TaskRun status or advance Workflow
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, and npm test pass with deterministic fakes only
tasks.output: Shared Workflow Session turn coordinator, atomically migrated OpenCode Workflow caller/wire, guarded runtime binding, and idempotent Server event cursor/seal
tasks.notes: Implementation is SDK-independent but deliberately ordered after T-001 because the smoke is the plan-wide pre-code gate and may reconcile shared design contracts. Deliver this as an OpenCode-preserving Session infrastructure change. Split the new Action event route instead of changing existing Follow-up/generic DTOs. Do not route public Follow-up/Compact/Reset/Cancel commands to Pi or let one Runner attest another Runner's local Action stream.

tasks.title: Implement the durable Workflow Session event outbox
tasks.description: Implement WorkflowSessionEventOutbox as the runtime-neutral owner of Workflow Action stream manifests, encoding, fingerprints, sequencing, acknowledgement compaction, reporting quarantine, and restart repair over injected byte storage. Add a separately testable atomic-replace protocol over low-level file operations, the thin production adapter, standalone initialization/readiness and drain services, injected Pi reconciliation hooks, and fenced prepareRebind using T-003's Action cursor/seal protocol. Do not compose RunnerHost or production Actions in this task.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowSessionOutboxStorage exposes list/read/replaceAtomically/remove byte operations; AtomicSnapshotReplaceProtocol owns write -> file sync -> same-directory rename -> directory sync -> cleanup ordering over injected low-level operations, while the production adapter only supplies Node filesystem operations

The real outbox codec/state machine runs over injected storage and keys one manifest by logical AgentSession plus the authority-issued actionStreamId returned by open/bind; it never derives or claims stream identity, and tests use in-memory bytes without host filesystem access

The outbox exposes one runtime-neutral binding-stream API for session.input and required pre-operation drain/fencing across Workflow turn, idle Follow-up, Compact, rebind, and Reset; fake OpenCode and Pi binding contract tests prove the same API against T-003's authority-issued stream state without modifying production handlers before T-006

Before Prompt admission the outbox atomically creates a manifest only for returned cursor 0, containing authority-issued stream identity, physical binding/repair target, next sequence initialized to returned cursor + 1, projector fingerprints, and active-turn checkpoint; session.input is Server-acknowledged and the checkpoint is durably marked admitted before the Runtime call

If Server cursor is nonzero and no matching local manifest exists, the outbox quarantines only that logical Session with session-reporting-failed/outbox-history-missing and admits no Prompt, rebind, or stream-drained Reset; it never reprojects old facts under new sequences, while unrelated streams remain available

Each required canonical Pi audit fact and updated projector fingerprint is one atomic snapshot replacement; final checkpoint closure occurs only after final assistant/reasoning, completed tool/result, model, and input/output/cache-read/cache-write/thought usage facts supplied by Pi are durable, and delivery occurs in monotonic sequence order

Ambiguous acknowledgement retries the same sequence, duplicate acknowledgement compacts once, and a Server gap retains/resends the missing prefix; post-turn transport failure preserves the completed Action result when records are durable and background/startup drain retries without Prompt replay

prepareTurn, prepareIdleFollowup, prepareCompact, prepareRebind, and prepareReset hold the stream fence and drain every locally issued sequence before Runtime entry; Compact releases without stream replacement, rebind/Reset supply expected identity plus final sequence to T-003's atomic replacement, and failure admits no Runtime operation

A post-admission local append failure fixes session-reporting-failed, interrupts an active Pi turn, quarantines that physical Session from later Prompt/rebind admission, retains the fact in memory, and does not replay the Prompt

Startup closes prepared-but-not-admitted checkpoints without Runtime replay; for admitted Pi checkpoints it opens the persisted Session through an injected repair hook, reconciles required final facts using persisted fingerprints, and clears reporting quarantine only after repair; an absent/unreadable Pi file records uncertain submission and leaves runtime-session-missing with Reset guidance without replacement or replay

A corrupt committed manifest is preserved and quarantines only its logical Session while unrelated streams remain drainable; root/list/atomic-capability initialization failure makes the standalone outbox readiness state not-ready with a stable workflow-session-outbox-unavailable diagnostic naming the failed operation/capability and an actionable masked message, and successful re-initialization clears the diagnostic; Runner registration/claim gating is owned by T-006

Atomic protocol tests over fake operations cover every write/sync/rename/directory-sync failure and classify rename-success/directory-sync-failure as commit-uncertain; a sentinel in a storage error is masked from readiness diagnostics, recovery clears that diagnostic, and fixed virtual paths assert same-directory rename and supported filesystem assumptions without instantiating the physical adapter

Codec/state-machine tests cover cursor-0 bootstrap producing first sequence 1, absent manifest with nonzero cursor quarantine, first Pi bind, pending-fact drains before idle OpenCode Follow-up/Compact, zero-event and non-empty OpenCode -> Pi -> OpenCode stream drain/rebind/Reset, Server/local identity or cursor disagreement, atomic old-or-new generations, append failure before/after admission, per-stream corruption, global storage readiness failure, duplicate/gap recovery, restart reconciliation/drain, pre-admission/pre-rebind failure, all usage dimensions, and no replay
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, and npm test pass
tasks.output: Crash-consistent Workflow Session outbox, injected byte storage and production file adapter, standalone readiness/drain/repair services, reporting quarantine, and deterministic recovery tests
tasks.notes: Implements D8's transport and local-persistence guarantees before the Pi Action consumes them. The outbox owns its format and recovery policy; the physical adapter owns only byte persistence. Never turn event-delivery or append failure into automatic Prompt replay.

tasks.title: Recognize Pi as a Workflow Inline Agent Action
tasks.description: Update Server Workflow validation, classification, translation, serialization, and parent-context selection to use the architecture-specified explicit Inline Agent Action set containing mohist/opencode and mohist/pi. Keep the change at the dispatch/presentation boundary so runtime implementation, AgentJob routing, and Session commands remain untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: Server static validation accepts uses=mohist/pi with prompt/session/options and rejects legacy with.agent, with.kind, and with.type before dispatch with an Action-specific message
TaskRun.DeriveClassification, WorkflowItemTranslator, and WorkflowYamlSerializer classify mohist/pi as UserFacing Inline Agent without substring matching or changing non-inline Actions

Plan-stage parent issue context is attached for mohist/opencode and mohist/pi only under the existing task/stage/parent guards defined in design/workflow/task-dispatch.md; checks, other stages, AgentJobs, and unrelated Actions remain excluded
Validation and dispatch diagnostics refer to the selected Action rather than hard-coding OpenCode
Server specs cover accepted Pi dispatch, every legacy field rejection, both Inline Agent classifications, serialization, parent-context inclusion/exclusion guards, and unchanged OpenCode behavior
npm test passes
tasks.output: Pi-aware Server Workflow validation, explicit Inline Agent classification, parent-context dispatch, and regression specs
tasks.notes: The authoritative parent-context design has already been updated during planning. Do not register the Runner Action, add Pi AgentJob routing, or change model catalog APIs in this task.

tasks.title: Deliver the mohist/pi Workflow execution path
tasks.description: Integrate PiRuntime and the durable reporter into RunnerHost and WorkExecutor, register the standalone mohist/pi Action, and connect it to the shared logical-Session coordinator, guarded binding, Workflow completion/promise projection, recovery, and cleanup reuse. Compose command leases and outbox drains into production OpenCode Action plus Workflow-origin idle Follow-up/Compact/Reset paths. This is the final Runner vertical slice; it consumes the already-tested runtime, Session wire, outbox, and Server dispatch boundaries without touching AgentJob or adding Pi Session-command routing.
acceptanceCriteria: RunnerHost creates one provider policy and credential masker, supplies them to OpenCode/Pi, is the sole owner that composes T-004 outbox initialization/background drain with both runtimes before Server registration, shuts them down together, periodically retries failed Pi/storage startup, and gates registration/new polling while still draining awaitingAck; Pi catalog data is not added to RunnerRegistration

ActionContext/baseContext/check/cleanup paths carry piRuntime and WorkflowSessionTurnCoordinator, createDefaultRegistry resolves mohist/pi, and ownerKind=agent-job continues to branch before Action resolution into OpenCode AgentJobExecutor

mohist/pi recursively consumes only expanded prompt/session/options; omitted or null session uses Work ID, explicit strings are trimmed, whitespace/non-string session fails before Session creation, options must be an object, model/variant accept only string or null, model requires a non-empty first-slash provider/model split, unknown option keys are diagnostic only, and top-level with.timeout/with.deadline is invalid

Workflow tests prove omitted model and variant independently avoid Runtime setters, preserve current selections on reused and restart-restored Sessions, and leave a new Session on Pi defaults when both are omitted
The Action has no hidden vars.agent fallback, Server-rejected legacy fields never execute, and slash-prefixed resolved Prompt text reaches Pi literally

Production mohist/opencode and mohist/pi Actions both consume T-004's binding-stream API; existing OpenCode creates/opens its authority-issued stream and reports session.input without connecting its full observer, Workflow-origin idle OpenCode Follow-up/Compact/Reset acquire command leases and drain pending facts, Compact/Reset complete through the acknowledged Runner callback before lease release, Reset atomically replaces its stream, while a first Pi turn enters the coordinator, rejects workDir mismatch, creates Pi, persists binding, creates its manifest, obtains input acknowledgement, marks admission, and only then calls prompt()

Same-name tasks, retries, cleanup, and Runner restart reuse one logical and physical Pi Session; model/variant changes preserve path and lineage; different logical names run independently; missing/corrupt bound Pi files fail without replacement and diagnose Reset as the future same-Session remedy plus a new logical session name as the recovery available now

The reporter durably projects required final assistant/reasoning, completed tool/result, model, and separate input/output/cache-read/cache-write/thought usage facts and closes the turn checkpoint before Action return; post-turn transport failure drains later without flipping success, while local append failure or a required pre-admission/pre-rebind drain failure maps to session-reporting-failed

Successful final assistant text reaches expect, failIf, artifact, recovery, and promise evaluation only through private turnFact; Action failure bypasses files/markers/missing-promise checks; public output is null or exactly {promise} and contains no runtime facts

All stable error mappings are covered: unavailable-runtime -> runtime-unavailable, missing-session -> runtime-session-missing, deadline-exceeded -> timeout, plus invalid-input, session-workspace-mismatch, session-binding-failed, session-reporting-failed, incompatible-runtime, interrupted, and turn-failed; binding failure submits no Prompt

WorkExecutor supplies immutable turnTimeoutMs=3600000 through private Action context regardless of input; PiRuntime starts it immediately before each original/cleanup SDK Prompt, and fake-timer tests prove queue/bind/input/model preparation does not consume the budget, each Prompt gets a fresh duration, warning occurs at 55 minutes, and timeout/abort at 60 minutes

External cancellation maps to interrupted, provider exhaustion remains turn-failed even when abort is unconfirmed, and reporting failure preserves its code; before runTurn the Action registers logical/physical tracking, every unconfirmed interruption installs matching logical quarantine before lease release, observed stop clears both physical and logical generations, stale clear is ignored, and Runner restart begins empty
Worktree enforcement reinvokes the already-resolved mohist/pi Action under the original task lease on the same physical Session; a queued same-name task cannot run or rebind between work and cleanup

Fake-timer RunnerHost specs cover pre-registration Pi/storage readiness, empty-catalog warning, periodic retry, registration/poll suppression, credential-redacted actionable workflow-session-outbox-unavailable diagnostic propagation, diagnostic clearing and registration recovery, unrelated per-stream corruption remaining available, and continued awaitingAck drain

Fake-backed Workflow specs cover open -> bind -> manifest/input acknowledgement -> Prompt/events -> final text -> expect/promise, exact input and every error mapping, same-session/cross-runtime serialization, command-first same-binding exclusion, idle OpenCode Follow-up/Compact/Reset lease and drain lifetimes, cleanup intervention exclusion, project/WorkflowRun/name isolation, runtime-switch rejection during unconfirmed stop, observed-stop logical admission recovery, stale quarantine generations, empty execution quarantine after host restart, cursor-0 first sequence, nonzero-cursor missing-manifest rejection, retry/reporting recovery, missing-file guidance/bind failure, all usage dimensions, event non-completion, timeout/cancellation/provider/reporting failure, and no replay

End-to-end credential tests inject a sentinel through fake Pi auth/provider surfaces and prove it is absent from Runner registration, Action-event requests, serialized outbox bytes, diagnostics, task logs, private turn facts, and public Action output while sanitized provider text retains the mask
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, and npm test pass
tasks.output: End-to-end Workflow-direct mohist/pi implementation across Runner host, Action, completion, Session binding/reporting, recovery, and cleanup with fake-backed Workflow coverage
tasks.notes: Consumes and composes all preceding boundaries; this is the only task that wires the outbox into RunnerHost or production Actions. The temporary runtime-bearing ActionContext and name-based promise/cleanup extension is explicitly owned for removal by issue #447; do not invent a competing capability abstraction. Keep Pi AgentJob execution, Pi Follow-up/Compact/Reset/Cancel routing, runtime-aware catalog reporting/UI, ACP/RPC, and a generic AgentRuntime out of scope.

AgentSessionUsage and every Web API adapter gain cachedWriteTokens; a Pi Workflow Session fixture renders assistant text, tool lifecycle, resolved model, distinct supplied input/output/cache-read/cache-write/thought values, reporting diagnostics, and Pi lineage through shared components without a Pi-specific duplicate view
